MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items meets a current need closely enough for me to choose it. My recent fastening purchases involve wood construction and framing, while locking nuts, washers and hose clamps serve different jobs.",
    "The BOSTITCH brad nails share a brand and product type with my purchases, but their gauge and length suit lighter trim work and require a compatible nailer; they do not replace my framing nails.",
    "My vacuum bag purchase does not mean I own an Oreck floor machine that takes the recommended brush.",
    "The capacitor, caliper, thermometer and specialized tape each need a specific task to make sense for me, and I have no current need for them. I also have no use for twelve small wastebaskets."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat interest in construction fasteners as interest in almost any hardware or repair supply.",
    "Sharing the BOSTITCH name or a broad cleaning purpose seems to count too heavily when the actual use and equipment requirements differ."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The dimensions, collation angle, shank and intended use of my framing nails matter because a similar-looking nail may not work with the same tool or task.",
    "My wood screw purchases point toward fastening wood, rather than bolted assemblies or hose repairs.",
    "Replacement cleaning supplies need to fit the equipment I use; my recent bags specifically name Panasonic compatibility.",
    "I choose supplies when they fit an immediate task, so a generally useful tool or an unrelated bulk pack is not enough to interest me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized a broad construction and maintenance interest but missed the specific tasks, fastener specifications and equipment compatibility that drive my choices."
}
